The camera pans across the spaceship corridor, showing the large panoramic windows facing outer space. The massive glowing alien jellyfish-like organism floats in space outside.

The camera focuses on Yellow, standing near a wiring panel, chewing a piece of bubble gum with a look of satisfaction.

Red is seen observing the bubble gum from across the corridor, raising an eyebrow.

Purple walks into frame, holding a piece of bubble gum and taking a curious sniff.

Scene 5 - 4s:
Cyan leans against a nearby metallic wall, chewing a piece of bubble gum with a relaxed expression.

Scene 6 - 5s:
The camera zooms in on the single piece of missing bubble gum on the ground, with the other heroes gathering around it.

Scene 7 - 6s:
Yellow bends down to pick up the missing bubble gum, and the other heroes follow suit.

Scene 8 - 7s:
Red looks puzzled, holding up a piece of bubble gum with an unclear flavor label.

Scene 9 - 8s:
Purple examines the label, then looks around at the other heroes with a mischievous grin.

Scene 10 - 9s:
Cyan starts chewing the missing bubble gum, and the others follow suit.

Scene 11 - 10s:
The camera cuts to a wide shot of all four heroes, now in a synchronized chewing motion, as they look out at the glowing alien jellyfish-like organism outside.

Scene 12 - 11s:
Yellow takes a step forward, looking directly at the camera with a playful expression.

Scene 13 - 12s:
The other heroes join Yellow, creating a chorus of exaggerated reactions and chuckles.

Scene 14 - 13s:
Red's eyes widen as they realize what happened to their bubble gum.

Scene 15 - 14s:
Purple starts laughing, holding up the label with a silly face drawn on it.

Scene 16 - 15s:
Cyan looks around at the other heroes, now all smiling and sharing in the joke.

Scene 17 - 16s:
The camera cuts to a shot of the alien jellyfish-like organism outside, which starts glowing brighter.

Scene 18 - 17s:
Yellow holds up the missing bubble gum, now with an added sticker that reads "Galaxy Flavors".

Scene 19 - 18s:
Purple leans in, examining the sticker, and then looks at Yellow with a curious expression.

Scene 20 - 19s:
Cyan smiles, holding up their own bubble gum with a similar sticker.

Scene 21 - 20s:
Red's face lights up as they realize they're not alone in their love for Galaxy Flavors.

Scene 22 - 21s:
The camera cuts to a montage of the heroes chewing and laughing together.

Scene 23 - 22s:
Yellow pulls out a small bag of bubble gum, now with the new "Galaxy Flavors" branding.

Scene 24 - 23s:
Purple opens the bag, releasing a burst of colorful confetti.

Scene 25 - 24s:
Cyan shares their own bag of bubble gum with Red, who eagerly takes a piece.

Scene 26 - 25s:
